archetype: Premium Obsidian & Electric Mint (Luxury Command Center)

headings.instruction: Do not use Inter for headings. Use Manrope for a geometric, architectural, high-end feel.

data_and_numbers.instruction: Strictly for KPI metrics, chart axes, table data, and deltas. Numbers must feel engineered.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: High Density Grid (Bento Mode B) mixed with Luxury Spacing. Information must be extremely clear and tabular.

kpi_card.label: text-xs text-[#A1A1AA] font-medium tracking-[0.05em] uppercase font-sans

tooltip.wrapper_classes: bg-[#121214]/95 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/[0.1] rounded-lg shadow-2xl p-4

gradients.instruction: Always use <defs> for Area charts. Use linearGradient (e.g., from #00E599 at 0.3 opacity to 0.0 opacity). Never use solid fills for areas.

motion.page_entrance: animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-700 ease-out fill-mode-both
motion.stagger_children: Use progressive delays (e.g. delay-[100ms], delay-[200ms]) on grid items for a cascade effect.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Muted text must not drop below #71717A on #09090B.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, and key data points MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='sales-tab-button').
accessibility.focus: Use focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#00E599] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#09090B].

what_to_avoid: No transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or headers. Always use solid surfaces or backdrop-blur-xl + color/opacity.
No drop shadows on cards in dark mode. Use crisp 1px subtle borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.06)) instead.
No Inter, Arial, or standard sans-serif for headings. Stick to Manrope.
No standard blue links. Action items should follow the monochrome or specific accent (Mint) strategy.
Avoid using .tsx files; project relies on .js files. Implement guidelines for React .js appropriately.
instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React components using .js files.
Apply styling strictly through Tailwind utility classes directly mimicking 'component_recipes'.
Use Recharts. Embed custom <Tooltip /> utilizing the classes defined in 'chart_palette.styling.tooltip.wrapper_classes'.
For the Bot Users drill-down table, use state toggles to reveal a secondary row (colSpan={all}) that contains the granular order history.
The Date Range segmented control should act as a toggle group (Today | 7d | 30d | 90d | 1y | All), driving state without full page reloads.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT:
- You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
- Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
- Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
- Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
- Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
- You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
- You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
- Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
- NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
- Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
- Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
- Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
- Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
- Component Reuse:
- Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
- Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
- Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
- Toasts:
- Use `sonner` for toasts
- Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`
- GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
